svg.title: Interleaved scans sort into one lane per SessionId on the tracking subscription, and one receiver drains each lane in order
svg.desc: Scanners send the scans of four parcels interleaved to the parcel-events topic. Its tracking subscription keeps one lane per SessionId, which is the tracking number, and three receivers of the scan-processor Functions trigger with IsSessionsEnabled = true each lock one lane and apply its scans in order: PickedUp, AtHub, OutForDelivery. The lanes run in parallel. The AtHub scan of PKG-100482 is abandoned and returns to the front of its lane, so OutForDelivery waits behind it while PKG-100483 and PKG-100484 keep moving; on the next delivery it succeeds. PKG-100484 gets no next scan, its lock is released after SessionIdleTimeout, and receiver 3 takes the waiting session PKG-100485. Each tracking page shows its parcel's scans in order.

g.text: no next scan, so the lock is released
